report.title: Porting result
report.subtitle: {name} → {key} · version {version}
report.percentLabel: of the work was done automatically (estimate)
report.percentHint: The estimate compares what was converted (settings, permissions, routes, tables, templates, phrases) with what is left to port by hand (lines of PHP and JavaScript, the TODO places in server.mjs).
report.todos: Places to fill in in server.mjs (TODO): {count}
report.contents: The archive contains the plugin folder, the installable package ({file}), the original sources (ORIGINAL/, as text only), PORTING.md and report.json.
report.nothingInstalled: Nothing was installed or enabled. The generated plugin is a skeleton: review and complete it before using it on a public site.
report.handoffHint: The package goes to the validation step of the plugin installer (Applications and plugins), where you decide. It is not installed or enabled automatically.
report.handoffBlocked: The generated package does not pass the checks, so it cannot be sent to the installer. Download the result, fix the plugin and upload it from Applications and plugins.
report.deleteConfirm: Delete this porting and its archives? The result you downloaded stays with you.

checks.title: Package checks
checks.hint: The same checks as when installing from Applications and plugins.

manual.title: Left to port by hand
manual.hint: The source code is in ORIGINAL/ (as text only); PORTING.md in the archive has the same table.
manual.none: Nothing to port by hand: everything recognized in the source was converted.

equivalents.controller: site page (routes.pages + pages in server.mjs); data from ctx.api and ctx.db
equivalents.acp_controller: ACP page (routes.acp + acp); configuration through the settings generated from the manifest
equivalents.api_controller: API route (routes.api + api), JSON, with the plugin's permissions
equivalents.model: table in the migration + access functions with ctx.db.query / ctx.db.execute
equivalents.service: functions in server.mjs (or server/*.mjs), called from pages, events and jobs
equivalents.extension: extension of a source platform class → event (events), the post.before_save filter or an extension point
equivalents.hook: hook → extension point (postbit.after_fields), widget or the post.before_save filter
equivalents.setup: install / upgrade → SQL migrations in migrations/ (the plugin's schema)
equivalents.widget: widget → widgets (sanitized HTML, rendered on the server)
equivalents.settings_form: the settings form is generated from the manifest; only special validations remain
equivalents.javascript: client JavaScript → client-js (GCS certified plugins only) or replaced with HTML/CSS
equivalents.other: to review: code without a direct equivalent
